162  async def image_rotate(context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  163      """Rotate image by specified angle."""
  164      try:
  165          from PIL import Image
  166      except ImportError:
  167          raise ModuleError("Pillow is required for image.rotate. Install with: pip install Pillow")
  168  
  169      params = context['params']
  170      input_path = params.get('input_path')
  171      output_path = params.get('output_path')
  172      angle = params.get('angle')
  173      expand = params.get('expand', True)
  174      fill_color = params.get('fill_color', '#000000')
  175  
  176      _validate_rotate_params(input_path, output_path, angle)
  177  
  178      def _rotate():
  179          with Image.open(input_path) as img:
  180              fill_rgb = _hex_to_rgb(fill_color)
  181  
  182              # Handle RGBA images
  183              if img.mode == 'RGBA':
  184                  fill_value = fill_rgb + (255,)
  185              else:
  186                  fill_value = fill_rgb
  187  
  188              rotated = img.rotate(
  189                  angle,
  190                  expand=expand,
  191                  fillcolor=fill_value,
  192                  resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,
  193              )
  194  
  195              os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path) or '.', exist_ok=True)
  196              rotated.save(output_path)
